title: OSD table of providers
description: Who supplies the sources of a descriptor, each cited by its identifier in the field `provider`. The table has a version of its own, beside the versions of the format.

version.description: The date of the last change of the table.

providers.description: The entries. An entry is never deleted and its identifier is never given to another provider.

id.description: The identifier a source cites; never reused.

name.description: The name as its owner writes it.

kind.description: Who the entry is: maker made the device or its software, community-firmware is a firmware made by people other than the maker, partner is a project whose data formats or catalogues OSD carries.

url.description: The web address of the provider.

midi_manufacturer_id.description: The MIDI manufacturer id, when one exists: one byte as two hexadecimal digits, or three bytes 00 xx xx as six.

credit.description: On a seeded entry, where the identifier, the name and the address were read, and the licence read there.

deprecated.description: The provider has ceased to exist, or the entry was a mistake.

replaced_by.description: The identifier of the entry that replaces a deprecated one.
